source: protocol/tolerances.json (v1, retained unchanged) amended only as fixed by protocol/amendments/protein-replacement-reviewed.md section 7 (sha256 e5ba0c347b66cba1c76dd249e386789c26e1916a95bc9c82a0208a696c89eae1), approved per protocol/amendments/2026-10-06-approved-protein-replacement.md
note: Numerical transcription of the approved section 7 only. No tolerance is widened, no tier reassigned and no metric dropped after any comparison is computed. v2 changes only the CITE fields listed in amendment section 7; no tier is widened.
close_definition: close(a,b;abs,rel): both finite and |a-b| <= abs + rel*max(|a|,|b|), or both in the same non-finite state (NaN, None/not attainable, -inf, +inf). A difference in state is a breach.

T1_exact.adt_count_tables_scope: eligible replacement files only (non-control columns: 29 for totalvi_pbmc5k_protein_v3, 14 for totalvi_pbmc10k_protein_v3)

replacement_items.replacement_input_sha256_equals_pins: acquisition.json identity sha256 equals the amendment section 2.2 pin, both files, both modes
replacement_items.eligibility_verdicts: per file (verdict, first failing criterion number) and n_eligible identical between modes; a different verdict is a T1 breach
replacement_items.mapping_csv: mapping_<name>.csv byte-identical (sha256) for every file that produced one in either mode
replacement_items.post_qc_barcodes: barcodes_qc_<name>.txt byte-identical (sha256) for every eligible file

CITE.source: Mode R eligibility.json (hashed); Mode F must reach identical verdicts (T1 eligibility_verdicts)
CITE.names: eligible_files from the same record; the CITE query/released/adt file sets must equal this list exactly

T2_labels.allowed_formula_cite: unchanged: max(1, floor(0.001*n)) per eligible CITE file (3 for 5k, 6 for 10k at full n)

T2_thresholds.rule: state identical (finite / -inf / not attainable); no numeric tolerance on finite values; report |delta tau|

T2_protein_gating.scope: eligible replacement CITE files; formula unchanged

M_metrics.methods: all methods including M6, all arms and the practical track
M_metrics.protein_fields_scope: eligible replacement CITE files; close(abs 0.01, rel 0) unchanged

S_sign.headline_definition: Mode R paired-difference CI excludes 0 and |mean_diff| > 0.01
S_sign.rule: Mode F mean_diff has the same sign and its CI also excludes 0
S_sign.near_zero_note: A change in CI-exclusion status with |mean_diff| <= 0.01 in both modes is reported as near-zero, not a sign breach

diagnostic.M6_heuristic_note: pre-registered heuristic with no empirical basis: no repeat scANVI CPU run exists

descriptive.rule: max |delta| reported; not gated; small n

not_toleranced.rule: flag when ratio > 2x (either direction); never a pass/fail numeric equality

outcomes.data_level: not reproduced at the data level
outcomes.m6_only_wording: consistent with non-deterministic CPU training (not verified)

cite_scope.files: the eligible replacement files: eligibility.json files[*].verdict == 'eligible' (eligible_files)
cite_scope.eligibility_record: <cite run dir>/eligibility.json, verified against <cite run dir>/eligibility.json.sha256 before use
cite_scope.rule_if_n_eligible_0: protein check 'not run'; zero CITE query files expected; protein M/T2 checks have no files and report not run
cite_scope.final_verification_wording: the eligible replacement files (in place of 'all four CITE files')
